name: Sieg Ivane
source:
The court doctor.
A close associate of the former king who made the clone of Cain.
He's been the protagonist and Cain's tutor since they were young and is the best acquainted with them.
He's the only one that knows that the current [url=/c54024]Cain[/url] is only a clone of the original.
translation:
The court doctor.
A close associate of the former king who made the clone of Cain.
He's been the protagonist and Cain's tutor since they were young and is the best acquainted with them.
He's the only one that knows that the current [url=/c54024]Cain[/url] is only a clone of the original.
